question: Which of the following is an example of good netiquette when participating in online discussion or forums?

options.text: Reading the discussion thread before posting to avoid repeating previous points

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reading the discussion thread before posting to avoid repeating previous points**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Good netiquette** is visualized by politeness, respect, politeness, and professionalism.
 
• It should generally refrain from writing messages or individual words wholely in capital letters – even if you want to give these sections more expressive.
 
• Reading the discussion thread before posting to avoid repeating previous points is a **good gesture of activeness**.
 
• Posting irrelevant or off-topic comments is **generally avoided** because it creates a bad impression.
 
• Attacking other users is a very **negative tone **of expressing in online forums.
